description: Current model-routing decision + per-model summary stats from calibration runs.

routing_decision.caveat: CIS pipeline currently runs rule-based (no LLM client, llm_client=None). --model flag is wired but has no effect through adr_audit.py → cli_arcs_run.py path. All 4 models produce identical rule-based envelopes (confirmed by calibration_20260826_1046: 20/20 calls, identical CSS per ADR). The 5.4× timing story (22.6s vs 122s) comes from the hermes chat + bare prompt path (narrow bench), not the adr_audit.py path. See ADR-033 Context point 1.

poolside/laguna-xs-2.1:free.notes: 5.4x faster than solar-pro4:free on Tier 3 bare-prompt path. Pure JSON. Rule-based CIS: identical to all models.

upstage/solar-pro4:free.notes: Current Hermes default. Prose-wrapped JSON on bare prompt. Rule-based CIS: identical to all models.

poolside/laguna-s-2.1:free.notes: Larger sibling of laguna-xs. Rule-based CIS: identical to all models.

stepfun/step-3.7-flash:free.notes: Multimodal MoE. Rule-based CIS: identical to all models.

calibration_runs.description: Real audit-bench: adr_audit.py --tier 1 --format json --model <model> across 5 ADRs × 4 models = 20 CIS-pipeline calls.
calibration_runs.key_finding: Model independence confirmed — all 4 models produce identical gate verdicts and CSS values per ADR. CIS pipeline is rule-based with no LLM client.
